KW1a.label: KW1a: reserve drops the tomorrow-feed buffer entirely (sd_wheat_tmrw_frac=0)

KW1b.label: KW1b: reserve halves the tomorrow-feed buffer (sd_wheat_tmrw_frac=0.5)

KW2.label: KW2: KW1a + also drops today's demand-carried term (reserve relies only on the tier's pending-pickup floor)

KW3.label: KW3: KW1a + proactive daily buy-back toward n_anim wheat each morning (mirrors the leader's habitual buy)

KWd1.label: KWd1: h23 sells all shed WHEAT (ignores every reserve/quota); daytime reserve formula UNCHANGED from K5b

KWd2.label: KWd2: KWd1 + sd_wheat_tmrw_frac=0 (also unblocks daytime selling, not just the h23 dump)

KWd1r.label: KWd1r: KWd1 + sd_wheat_h23_buy_room=1 (sell other goods to make room before the wheat buy, retry at hour1)

KWd2r.label: KWd2r: KWd2 + sd_wheat_h23_buy_room=1 (sell other goods to make room before the wheat buy, retry at hour1)

KWd1p.label: KWd1p: KWd1 + sd_wheat_h23_pickup_room=1 (hour-0 farmer PICKUP frees room instead of selling first)

KWd2p.label: KWd2p: KWd2 + sd_wheat_h23_pickup_room=1 (hour-0 farmer PICKUP frees room instead of selling first)
